scripts.name: a question about the lighthouse walk

when.user_text: What did I decide about the lighthouse walk?

blocks.text: I will look through your earlier chats.

In your chat **Planning the lighthouse walk** you decided to walk to the old lighthouse on Saturday, and what to bring: water, a windproof jacket, shoes with a good grip, food and a paper map. The cliff path is the shorter way, about seven kilometres there and back, but slower.
